read.thesis: Hilton Q3 2026: RevPAR +5.8% and record 27k organic room openings, with 543k-room pipeline and 40% construction-start growth; FY RevPAR guide trimmed to 4-4.5% on Middle East, China and timeshare.

triggers.label: Business transient RevPAR up 83.3%
triggers.quote: Globally, business transient RevPAR was up 83.3% driven by outperformance in The US

triggers.label: FY EBITDA $4.06-4.08B; EPS cut
triggers.quote: We expect adjusted EBITDA of between $4.06 billion and $4.08 billion and diluted EPS adjusted for special items of between $9.07 and $9.13

triggers.label: Construction starts up 40%+ YoY
triggers.quote: System wide new development construction starts continue to show incredible momentum up over 40% year over year in the quarter

triggers.label: Middle East RevPAR low double-digit decline
triggers.quote: We now expect full year RevPAR in the region to decline by a low double digit percentage

guidance.quote: For the full year, we expect RevPAR growth between 4-4.5% driven by continued business strength
We expect adjusted EBITDA of between $4.06 billion and $4.08 billion
diluted EPS adjusted for special items of between $9.07 and $9.13
we expect to return approximately $3.5 billion to shareholders in the form of buybacks and dividends
expect fourth quarter net unit additions to be above the third quarter ending the year around the midpoint of our 6% to 7% range for 2026

guidance.value: 6% to 7% annually over next several years
guidance.quote: We also expect to grow 6% to 7% annually over the next several years.
next year we feel pretty darn good that global RevPAR numbers are going to be in the 3% to 4% range

guidance.metric: Middle East and Africa RevPAR FY2026
guidance.quote: We now expect full year RevPAR in the region to decline by a low double digit percentage
Capital Expenditures -- $350 million to $375 million projected for the full year

red_flags.label: Owner-side margin strain and ownership renovation drag
red_flags.quote: it is been a rough extended period of time for owners

red_flags.label: Timeshare license fees underperforming
red_flags.quote: license fees in the timeshare segment are not performing at the level that we had expected

evasions.quote: it is probably $60 million to $70 million maybe even a little bit more
